plot-title: Societal domain distribution by corpus (top 12 categories)
plot-caption: We compare the societal domains the norms govern, showing the 12 categories with the largest pooled share. This is the only axis with a non-trivial shift (total variation distance, TVD = 0.205; Jensen-Shannon divergence, JSD = 0.104), driven by the larger fiction10 share of social-propriety, courtship, and governance norms. However, the same-book analysis shows most of this gap is free-text label-vocabulary noise rather than corpus composition.
